evidence: The ALD process was carried out in a custom thermal ALD system at a chamber pressure of 2 mbar applying different deposition temperatures as a function of the Mo precursor: MoCl5 (300 °C), Mo(CO)6 (167 °C) and Mo(NMe2)2 (NtBu)2 (275 °C). The MoSe2 deposition was explored using different substrates: Si wafer (with thin native SiO2 on its surface), annealed Ti foils (with a thin anatase thermal TiO2 layer on the foil surface) and a soda lime glass. Regardless the precursors used, the same ALD parameters were applied in all the processes. Thus, one growth ALD cycle was defined by the following sequence: Se precursor (400 ms) – N2 purge (5 s) – Mo precursor (400 ms) – N2 purge (5 s).
